pageIntro: Every dollar helps us keep busting ghosts and supporting communities across Virginia.
donationText: Ghostbusters Virginia is a volunteer-run, community-focused franchise. Your generous donations help us support local charities and purchase supplies and prizes for our games.
donationCardHeading: Often Donated to Toys for Tots
donationItems: Sports balls and outdoor play items
donationImageAlt: Ghostbusters Virginia members visiting kids in the hospital
communityText: We're ready to benefit you!  If your event supports a local charity,  Ghostbusters, Virginia would love to participate.  We’ll bring the fun and help raise funds for your cause.
volunteerText:
Volunteers help Ghostbusters Virginia deliver welcoming, community-first events that raise awareness and support local causes. Opportunities include event setup and breakdown support, charity table staffing and family engagement, photography and social coverage support, and community outreach coordination.

No prior prop-building or costume experience is required to contribute.
initiativeText: Proton Pets is our pet pantry initiative supporting local shelters and families with practical, community-powered help through drives, outreach, and fundraising events.
initiativeDetailText: Visit the dedicated Proton Pets page to see upcoming events, learn where support is needed most, and find ways to get involved.
communityImageAlt: Two Ghostbusters Virginia members posing with a Slimer prop and Stay Puft Marshmallow Man background
volunteerImageAlt: Ghostbusters Virginia members visiting a local fire station
metaDescription: Support Ghostbusters Virginia through donations, community partnerships, and volunteer opportunities.
ogDescription: Help fund Ghostbusters Virginia's charitable events and community outreach across the Commonwealth.
